export type User = {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  name: string;
  createdAt: string;
};

const users: User[] = [
  { id: "1", email: "ada@example.com", name: "Ada", createdAt: "2026-01-04" },
  { id: "2", email: "grace@example.com", name: "Grace", createdAt: "2026-02-11" },
];

export async function listUsers(): Promise<User[]> {
  return users;
}

export async function getUser(id: string): Promise<User | undefined> {
  return users.find((u) => u.id === id);
}

// TODO: there is no real session handling yet — the dashboard just picks the first user.
export async function getCurrentUser(): Promise<User | undefined> {
  return users[0];
}

content.text:
I added the 10-minute reminder job, but nothing in the app calls `createUser` yet, so it won't run until something does. `src/lib/users.ts` had no create function, so I added `createUser` there. The type check shows one error, `LayoutProps` not found in `src/app/layout.tsx`, which I didn't touch. Lint is clean. I haven't run the job end to end.

**What I picked:** Inngest. It handles delayed runs and retries on its own, so there's no Redis or worker process to run. It serves its jobs from a Next.js route.

**How it works:**
- **Scheduling:** `createUser` in `src/lib/users.ts` adds the user to the in-memory list. It then sends a `notely/user.created` event with a timestamp 10 minutes ahead, so Inngest holds it until then. If scheduling fails, the error is logged and the user is still created.
- **The job:** `src/inngest/functions.ts` defines `userReminder`, which logs `Reminder: say hello to <name> <email> …` along with the attempt number. If it throws, Inngest retries it with backoff, up to 4 retries.
- **Wiring:** `src/inngest/client.ts` holds the shared client. `src/app/api/inngest/route.ts` exposes the job to Inngest.
- **Credentials:** `.env.example` has placeholder values for `INNGEST_EVENT_KEY` and `INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY`. I also added an exception in `.gitignore`, because `.env*` was ignored and the template wouldn't have been committed.

**To try it locally:**
1. Run `npx inngest-cli@latest dev`.
2. Set `INNGEST_DEV=1`.
3. Run `npm run dev`.

In production, replace the placeholder keys with real ones from the Inngest dashboard.
